rationale: Both describe increased fat mass, differing only in wording.
Impaired oligodendrocyte maturation and decreased oligodendrocyte differentiation describe essentially the same reduced developmental progression of oligodendrocytes.
Both concern laminin binding, but one is binding of laminin and the other is disrupted laminin-integrin binding, so the functional relationship needs curator review.
All share PPAR as the object, but they cover stressor binding, disrupted nuclear signaling and activation, which are distinct processes.
Both concern the ryanodine receptor, but one is activation and the other is hyperphosphorylation of RyR2.
Both concern aromatase activity in opposite directions, inhibition versus induction.
Both concern the PI3K-Akt pathway, one activated and the other inhibited.
Both describe increased estradiol, but one is specific to plasma while the other refers to general availability.
